jsonld.name: Wilfredo's Moving
jsonld.description: Local and long distance moving company in Hialeah, FL: residential moving, packing and wrapping, furniture and specialty item handling.

script.en: Your things, handled like our own.

parrafo.es: Wilfredo y su equipo mueven casas y apartamentos en Hialeah y el sur de la Florida, desde mudanzas locales hasta traslados a Fort Lauderdale y Orlando. Todo envuelto, cargado y entregado con el mismo cuidado que describen sus propios clientes.
parrafo.en: Wilfredo and his crew move homes and apartments across Hialeah and South Florida, from local moves to relocations as far as Fort Lauderdale and Orlando. Everything wrapped, loaded and delivered with the same care his own clients describe.

hero.imagen_alt: Wilfredo's Moving branded box truck parked and ready for a move in Hialeah, FL

parrafo_1.es: Wilfredo's Moving es una empresa de mudanzas familiar con base en Hialeah. Wilfredo, Angel y su equipo hacen mudanzas locales y de larga distancia, con todo el embalaje, envoltura y carga incluidos en el servicio.
parrafo_1.en: Wilfredo's Moving is a family-run moving company based in Hialeah. Wilfredo, Angel and the rest of the crew handle local and long distance moves, with all the packing, wrapping and loading included in the job.

parrafo_2.es: Reseña tras reseña describen lo mismo: puntuales, rápidos y meticulosos envolviendo cada mueble. Jacqueline Ramirez confió en ellos muebles, cristalería, televisores y obras de arte, y todo llegó entero a su nueva casa.
parrafo_2.en: Review after review describes the same thing: punctual, fast and meticulous about wrapping every piece of furniture. Jacqueline Ramirez trusted them with furniture, crystal, TVs and artwork, and everything arrived in one piece at her new house.

items.quote: Wilfredo and his team Angel and the young kid were awesome. Super meticulous, fast and made sure everything was wrapped up and protected. First time that I hire a moving company and i made a great choice going with them. 100% recommended.
Reliable, professional, on-time, fast, and super efficient. Wilfredo and his crew took exceptional care of all my belongings.
I hired this company for a move from Miami Lakes to Ft. Lauderdale. It was my first time hiring movers and I didn't know what to expect but Wilfredo made my moving process so much easier.
This gentleman is a genuine professional with years of experience! Wilfredo came to our home first to assess the scenario and explain everything in detail.
